_comment: Multi-target (polypharmacology-style) generation: one GA population scored jointly against several acaricide targets at once, instead of one independent run per target. Uses real, literature-backed ligand seeds (joined from the two raw pesticide reference CSVs) instead of generic placeholders -- falls back to seed_smiles if no real ligand is found for any of the targets.
_targets_comment: Example: 3 acetylcholinesterase targets + 2 nicotinic AChR targets -- a candidate that scores well against all 5 jointly is a broader-spectrum acaricide bet than one tuned to a single target.
_aggregation_comment: 'min' rewards candidates good against ALL targets (worst-case); 'mean' rewards good-on-average candidates; 'weighted' needs target_weights below.
_seed_smiles_comment: Fallback only, used if use_real_seeds finds nothing for these targets.
